newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling gains against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling gains against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling posted marginal gains against the dollar on Thursday in a fairly active market, commercial dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 56.87 against the dollar from 56.97 on Wednesday. On the pound, it was posted at an average of 89.04 from 89.345 on Wednesday.
"Interbank activity was high as most players started qouting prices after trading in-house from the last few days", a dealer said.
"However, the demand could not march the supply leading the shilling to gain marginally versus the dollar.
The shilling range was around 56.90/57/10 to 56.95/57.15.
"Exporters are dissapointed in its earlier gains and have started to unwind their long dollar positions," a trader said.
Dealers said overnight money market rates failed to maintain the previous day's lows of 5-10 percent levels as lenders opted to hold on to funds unless takers paid rates of 13 percent or higher.
